'''Glaive Squadron''' was an elite [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] squadron within the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was identified by a crimson-red hull, not unlike the [[Emperor's Royal Guard TIE/IN starfighter]]s. [[Countess/Legends|Countess]] [[Iran Ryad]] was a former member of the unit.<ref name="Imperial Veterans">{{FFGXW|set=Imperial Veterans Expansion Pack}}</ref>
